evals.name: palette-from-project
evals.prompt: /record-demo root/project: open the palette with Ctrl K and type "font"
evals.expected_output: An MP4 in target/demos that opens on the project mock, shows the palette opening and the query being typed, and a contact sheet the agent read before replying.
assertions: The preview tab opens port 8765 with the path /?mock=root/project
The agent runs keep-painting.js in the tab before it starts recording
The agent pauses with preview_evaluate and a setTimeout promise, never a foreground sleep
The video is saved under target/demos with a name that starts with root-project
The agent reads a contact sheet of the video and describes its first and last frames
The agent closes the tab it opened, and the server is still running at the end

evals.name: unknown-mock
evals.expected_output: The snapshot's console shows the panic for the unknown mock, and the agent tells the user without recording.
assertions: The final message says no mock is called root/nope

evals.name: no-flow
evals.expected_output: The agent asks what flow to record and records nothing.
assertions: The final message asks for the flow
